inventory_digest_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines '<zip path with forward slashes>,<uncompressed bytes>,<compressed bytes>', sorted by zip path and joined with LF without a trailing LF.

notes: ADAPT_OK.parent_qtable_files order is authoritative and is not re-sorted.
Manifest basenames are resolved only among direct clean-job children for the same arm and seed.
Monitor-prefix file sets include the original runner's broad-glob extras and are validated exactly as listed.
